status: Frozen independent evaluation protocol before reading implementation outputs
independence: Instrument rosters and system groupings come from the earlier full-source visual audit, reverified against unchanged PDF/render hashes.
System transitions, organ grouping, opening omissions and terminal bar counts were reread before candidate outcomes.
Staff line coordinates come directly from PDF path objects; no current or proposed detector result defines the source truth.

The three real documents have no within-document same-count/different-roster transition. A separately authored three-system source fixture tests that ambiguity; do not count it as a real corpus example.
No candidate thresholds, confidence values or matching outputs may alter these assertions. New findings are additive reports, not changes to source oracles.

seedScenarios.name: no-reviewed-template
seedScenarios.expectation: System boundaries may be proposed, but no unreviewed instrument roster may be silently committed.

seedScenarios.name: first-real-system-only
seedScenarios.seeds: First complete system of each document, with its source roster.
seedScenarios.expectation: Never map an unseen roster by modulo, divisibility, nearest staff count, or truncating a known roster. Report unresolved systems individually.

seedScenarios.name: all-real-templates-reviewed
seedScenarios.expectation: Measure correct complete-system reuse across all82 actual source systems. Abstention is safe but must reduce coverage; zero false assignments is mandatory. Partial matches never count as successful complete systems.

metrics: Complete-system boundaries: exact source staff-rank set, correct page, no split, merged, duplicated, skipped or cross-system staff.
Instrument assignment: every retained physical staff belongs to the correct named part in source order; count matches alone do not pass.
Coverage: proposals, reused correct assignments, explicit manual seeds, unresolved systems and every false assignment, separately per complete document.
Unchanged manual decisions: previously reviewed assignments and deliberate corrections are not overwritten by propagation.
Silence: each omitted roster member is an explicit counted rest or an unresolved count awaiting confirmation; absence is never silently dropped.
Duration: use target-system source counts or reviewed target counts, never a copied seed count; no fabricated count from staff identity.
Starting bar numbers belong to the target system; reusing instrumentation must not copy the seed's starting number.
Repeated proposal/application must be deterministic and must not duplicate systems, staff rows or omitted rests.
Template source bindings and profile identities must survive unchanged replay but invalidate on conflicting source, staff group or roster edits.

silenceTruth.mendelssohnPrintedOpeningRests: All four voice staves are actually printed in the seven bars of page1; do not replace their identities with omissions merely because they contain rests.

barCountChallenges.expectation: Roster reuse may remain a proposal, but omitted-part rows require target count confirmation before finalized output.

sameCountAmbiguity.expectation: Two structurally identical five-staff templates have different named recipients. The unlabelled third system must remain unresolved. An explicitly reviewed choice may resolve it; array order or last-used template may not.

boundaryNegatives.expectation: Reject seed/reuse: ranks belong to two different printed systems despite matching two-staff piano count.
Do not learn or apply this as the complete system: printed voice rank5 is part of the same source system.
Reject lower Piano staff from system4 plus Voice from system5 as a new two-staff system.
Final printed Voice rank7 cannot disappear when Piano subgroup is selected or when tempo/notation changes.
A brace around the two manuals is not the complete three-staff Organ system; rank3 pedal remains required.
Reject Bass plus two manuals as Organ-only: same count, wrong identities, excluded pedal7.
Reject previous pedal plus next Alto/Bass as an Organ-only system.
Five surviving detected staves cannot stand for a complete Alto/Bass/Organ system: source still prints Soprano/Tenor. Defer instead of silently omitting them.
Do not relabel Alto/Bass/two manuals as Bass plus three-staff Organ after a pedal miss.

boundaryNegatives.insertObservedStaff: Five nominal lines between the two genuine Piano staves where no source staff exists.
boundaryNegatives.expectation: Reject a source-unsupported third staff; do not change Piano-only to Voice+Piano.
Ordering must be normalized from physical source or rejected; pedal/manual identities must not follow arbitrary input order.

boundaryNegatives.sourceMutation: Keep source PDF and detected staff positions unchanged; remove/mark unavailable system-boundary evidence from the matcher input.
boundaryNegatives.expectation: Abstain when a complete source-supported system cannot be established; do not substitute modulo grouping.

bindingNegatives: A template learned from another document must not be silently applied through reused IDs or a stale UI task result.
If its reviewed part roster/staff counts change, require fresh matching or review instead of preserving old recipient mapping.
No proposal may consume a staff already committed to a different reviewed source system.
Cancelled/stale proposal results must not mutate current assignments.
scopeLimits: This protocol evaluates initialization identity, physical grouping and omitted duration, not crop ink preservation or finished output typography.
Safe abstention on a negative is success; abstention on a supported complete real system is recorded as reduced usefulness.
The incomplete-staff input cases are deliberate robustness challenges. Report them separately from clean native page inputs.
Only21 source pages are represented; no whole-corpus readiness claim follows from passing them.
